title: MdmServerProductFamily
description:
Strings that represent a product family that can be assigned as a default to a device management service.

Introduced in Apple Business API 2.6.

- Possible Values
  
  - APPLE_TV: Apple TV.
  - IPAD: iPad.
  - IPHONE: iPhone.
  - IPOD: iPod touch.
  - MAC: Mac.
  - VISION: Apple Vision Pro.
  - WATCH: Apple Watch.
